scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of the integrated-curvature cusp and elliptic scaling; finite deterministic checker is corroborative only. Fuller 1998 inflection theorem is previously known, not novel.
scientific_limitations: Standard embedded circular-torus parametrization, p fixed for the high-q limit; no minimization over knot isotopy class, no independent priority certification. The inflection threshold is credited to Fuller (1998).
title: Logarithmic total-curvature cusp and an elliptic double-scaling law for torus knots
